subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: Being young and old: ways to help elderly people; card of appreciation for grandparents

show.line: Gogo and mkhulu are old. Babies are young. We can help them both!

rounds.prompt: Gogo cannot see well. How can you help?
rounds.praise: Read to gogo or find her glasses!

rounds.prompt: Gogo gave you a gift. What do you say?

rounds.story: There is one seat on the taxi. An old man is standing. Lindi is sitting. What can Lindi do?
rounds.praise: Give him the seat! Kind Lindi.

hints: Old people may need help to walk, see or carry.
Being kind to elders shows respect.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! An old lady needs a seat.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: I keep the seat. It is mine!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I should give her my seat.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's give our seat to the old lady!

parent_line: Can describe ways to help older people and show respect.
